description: Connects a child pathway to its parent in the Reactome pathway hierarchy. The selected hierarchy roots also connect to a synthetic Reactome root.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources providing this relationship; Reactome.

common_properties.name: version
common_properties.description: Reactome release number in which this relationship was last seen.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time this relationship was created or last updated.

source_contributions.scope: Human BioPAX pathways within Signaling Pathways (R-HSA-162582; historically Signal Transduction), Immune System (R-HSA-168256), and Diseases of signal transduction by growth factor receptors and second messengers (R-HSA-5663202), including all descendant pathways.
source_contributions.description: Represents direct sub-pathway links where both child and parent are in scope. A pathway can have several parents. Links to parents outside these hierarchies are absent. The selected hierarchy roots each link to the synthetic Pathway reactome:root, which supplies a common ancestor and is not a source pathway.
